---
title: "Budget and Revenue"
---

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
```

Does having a bigger budgets result in a bigger box-office returns? @fig-budget-revenue
plots each film's budget against its Worldwide revenue. The values are in millions of US Dollars. 

```{python}
#| label: fig-budget-revenue
#| fig-cap: "Budget against Worldwide revenue"
#| echo: true

plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Budget (musd)")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide revenue (musd)")
plt.show()
```
